records.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / food product collection photograph. Create ONE exquisitely art-directed, photorealistic overhead food photograph, vertical 4:5 width:height 0.8, ideally 1600x2000. This is a future Korean instant-rice seasonal collection. EXACTLY FOUR shallow round plain white ribbed microwave rice bowls, photographed together on ONE continuous very pale warm ivory matte tabletop. No text, numbers, logos, printed designs or watermark; all calendar typography will be added afterwards.
The four delicious rice bowls form a balanced SQUARE AROUND AN EMPTY CENTER, with generous clear outer margins for a calendar ring. The TOP 26 percent must be empty pale ivory for headline and logo.
Precise positions using 1080x1350 reference layout: four bowls each about 260px in diameter, centered at (735,645) TOP RIGHT, (735,1035) BOTTOM RIGHT, (345,1035) BOTTOM LEFT, (345,645) TOP LEFT. These are relative layout coordinates, not numbers to draw. Keep the central area around (540,840), diameter180px, completely empty tabletop for a central calendar motif. Keep an empty outer circular band around the group, radius420-470px from (540,840), where fine calendar labels will be professionally added later. Do not draw the calendar. Scale the geometry naturally to the output. Bowls should not touch or overlap. Fully in frame. A premium still-life, not a four-panel collage.
Each bowl represents one season through appetizing REAL cooked ingredients, not fantasy landscapes:
TOP RIGHT / spring: tender glossy pearly white and barley rice, fresh small bright green spring chive pieces and a few fresh green broad-bean/pea accents, subtle pale green and ivory, delicate natural seasonal herb garnish.
BOTTOM RIGHT / summer: plump ivory rice and golden cooked sweetcorn with small millet grains, a few tender pale yellow pieces, sunny fresh yellow and cream, realistic freshly cooked textures.
BOTTOM LEFT / autumn: brown mixed-grain rice with a few succulent golden chestnut pieces and caramel-brown mushrooms, deep russet and golden-brown, savory and aromatic, NOT dry nuts on raw grains.
TOP LEFT / winter: delicious muted lavender black-rice mix with small tender translucent cooked white radish cubes, winter ivory and restrained violet, plump and steaming, NOT dark beans piled high.
All four are still clearly RICE, not salad, soup or raw grain display. Individual cooked short grains naturally irregular and modestly moist, mostly opaque, no gelatinous pearls or oil gloss. Ingredients are seasonal creative flavor suggestions, not nutrition/medical claims.
Packaging: authentic low shallow white instant-rice trays, refined clean slightly scalloped/ribbed sides. Each has a small modest plain silver/white peel-film remainder at the OUTSIDE rear rim, showing they are opened individual rice products. No giant wrappers, no faces or hands, no extra bowls, spoons, raw ingredients or separate props.
Lighting: soft clean natural daylight from upper left, very fine credible contact shadows close to the bowls, excellent realistic food microtexture, editorial commercial photography. Crisp but not sterile, warm-neutral whites, restraint and beauty. Avoid oversaturated ingredient colors, glitter, heavy steam, magical elements, cartoon/CGI look. Only very subtle real warmth, no steam that obstructs the empty calendar band.
This image is a background photograph for a designed 24-season edible-calendar poster. Exactly four REPRESENTATIVE bowls, one per season; do NOT create 24 bowls or any labels. All four bowls should look equally beautifully crafted and physically real, with the four seasonal palettes distinct. Keep the central void and outer typography band genuinely clean. No text or numbers anywhere.

records.prompt: Edit this food photograph into a precise graphic-design-ready editorial background. On a 1080x1350 reference canvas, required four bowl centres are top left (345,645), top right (735,645), bottom left (345,1035), bottom right (735,1035); diameter 260px each. This means all bowls must sit well INSIDE the page, leaving broad blank 200px left and right bands, a 510px blank top region, and a clear blank cross between bowls. Exactly FOUR bowls, no extras. Same ivory paper tabletop seamless with natural soft shadows. Top left winter: purple black rice with opaque white radish cubes. Top right spring: ivory barley-rice with thin chopped green wild chive leaves and minced wild chive roots, NO large green beans, NO green peas. Bottom left autumn: brown multigrain rice with chestnuts and shiitake slices. Bottom right summer: yellow corn-and-millet rice. Make food very photorealistic and delicious. Do NOT enlarge food for impact; keeping each bowl diameter 24% of page width is essential for the design. NO words, logos, calendar marks, arrows or numbers. All remaining space completely empty ivory background.
